_comment: Example Claude Code settings for the the-pause methodology. Copy the bits you want into your project's .claude/settings.json (or ~/.claude/settings.json). The two hooks below are the only project-specific behaviours this methodology relies on. Personal tooling (rtk, custom statusline) and external marketplace plugins from the author's machine are intentionally omitted — add your own if you use them.

hooks._comment: Python only: auto-run ruff lint --fix + format on any .py file Claude edits. Remove this hook if you're not on Python. See standards/rules/python-tooling.md for the import/orphan caveat.
hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE_PATH=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *.py ]]; then .venv/bin/ruff check --fix --quiet "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; .venv/bin/ruff format --quiet "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0'

hooks._comment: Stack-agnostic: scan each edited file for DECISION/ASSUMPTION/DEBT markers and append new ones to .claude/cognitive_debt.md. Feeds /debt-check and /debt-review. Adjust the path to wherever you place the hook script.
